description: This file defines API wrapper functions for a frontend application, including HTTP methods (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH), error handling, and specific endpoints related to work items and comments. It manages authorization headers, error responses (including auto-logout on 401), and interacts with local storage for user data.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (no authorization needed), specifically /auth/login and /auth/signup.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers, adding Authorization header if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles failed HTTP responses; on 401 unauthorized, clears auth and redirects to login page.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend API, returns JSON or null, throws on error.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON or throws error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON payload, returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, automatically retrieves author ID from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with details, using displayName from localStorage for creator info.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given API path.
